shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/charts version --json && npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies --json'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit versions --json | tail -30; npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@8 version peerDependencies --json; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version peerDependencies --json; npm view @gravity-ui/yagr@4 version peerDependencies --json'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 peerDependencies dependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 peerDependenciesMeta --json; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 peerDependencies dependencies --json; npm view @gravity-ui/yagr@4.14.1 peerDependencies dependencies --json'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- docs ---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null || true; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit -name 'README.md' -o -name 'INDEX.md' | head; printf '%s\\n' '--- types ---'; rg -n \"export .*Chart|type=|plugins|ChartKitProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -100; printf '%s\\n' '--- package exports ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- readme ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/README.md; printf '\\n--- index types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- plugin types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- chartkit component ---\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/ChartKit.d.ts; printf '\\n--- uikit segmented ---\\n'; rg -n \"declare function SegmentedRadioGroup|declare const SegmentedRadioGroup|export .*Segmented\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; printf '\\n--- uikit card ---\\n'; rg -n \"declare const Card|function Card\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build -g 'types*'; printf '\\n--- segmented ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; printf '\\n--- card ---\\n'; sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts; printf '\\n--- chartkit types find ---\\n'; rg -n \"export type ChartKitProps|ChartKitType|data.*ChartKit\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- gc types ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- yagr types ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- gc widget ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/renderer/GravityChartsWidget.d.ts; printf '\\n--- yagr widget ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export type ChartData|export interface ChartData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -20; rg -n \"export type RawSerieData|export interface RawSerieData|type RawSerieData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; printf '\\n--- charts docs ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts -path '*docs*INDEX.md' -o -name README.md | head; printf '\\n--- yagr docs ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr -name README.md -o -path '*docs*INDEX.md' | head"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"## Line|### line|type: 'line'|ChartData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -40; rg -n \"graphs|timeline|MinimalValidConfig|useState\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md | head -60; sed -n '280,330p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '30,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md; rg -n \"color|title|legend|tooltip\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -60; rg -n \"declare function Flex|const Flex|export declare\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | sed -n '1,180p'; printf '\\n--- box ---\\n'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts; printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n'; cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts; printf '\\n--- styles import path ---\\n'; rg -n '\"./styles|exports' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -40; printf '\\n--- css files ---\\n'; rg --files src"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '40,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- widget registry ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/widget.d.ts; printf '\\n--- yagr widget js ---\\n'; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export interface ChartData|export type ChartData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -20; rg -n \"xAxis|ChartSeries|LineSeries|interface Series\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '30,115p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts; sed -n '1680,1810p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/config/chart-config.d.ts; printf '\\n--- axis ---\\n'; rg -n \"type ChartXAxis|interface ChartXAxis\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/config/chart-config.d.ts | head"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"type ValueFormat|interface ValueFormat\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/config/chart-config.d.ts | head -10; rg -n \"const TOOLTIP_HEADER_FORMAT|headerFormat.*custom|type: \\\"custom\\\"\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/config/chart-config.d.ts | head -20; sed -n '440,590p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/config/chart-config.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/main.tsx; cat package.json | head -60; rg -n \"install|dependencies\" package-lock.json | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist/typings.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils | head -30; rg -n \"format\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apply_patch || ls /usr/local/bin/apply_patch /usr/bin/apply_patch 2>/dev/null || true; which git; git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json | rg -n '\"version\"'; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json'); console.log(p.dependencies['@gravity-ui/yagr'])\"; rg -n \"interface RawSerieData|type RawSerieData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; rg -n \"interface YagrConfig|type YagrConfig|timeMultiplier\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "cat src/DataVisualizer.tsx; printf '\\n--- adapters ---\\n'; cat src/dataAdapters.ts; printf '\\n--- dependencies ---\\n'; node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.dependencies)\"; printf '\\n--- lazy chunks ---\\n'; ls dist/assets | rg 'YagrWidget|GravityChartsWidget'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- src/App.tsx src/DataVisualizer.tsx src/dataAdapters.ts src/monitoringData.ts src/salesData.ts package.json && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"settings.set|ChartKit type=|import\\(\" src/DataVisualizer.tsx; npm run build -- --outDir /tmp/widget-dist --emptyOutDir >/tmp/widget-build.log 2>&1; tail -12 /tmp/widget-build.log"
